title: Phosphorus pentachloride in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of PCl₅ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Five bonding regions surround phosphorus: three are equatorial and two axial. The ideal structure is trigonal bipyramidal.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Five bonding regions surround phosphorus: three are equatorial and two axial. The ideal structure is trigonal bipyramidal.
